item.title: Demonstrate Ownership in Interviews 🚀 • Share specific examples of initiatives you led. • Use: “I improved process efficiency by 20%.” • Explain how you tackled unexpected challenges. • Show metrics—numbers speak louder than words. • Highlight your role in team successes. How can you demonstrate proactive ownership in your next interview? #interviews #career #ScalePilot #SocialPilot #AIAutomations
